key_features: AI/Agentic chatbot with NLU, multi-step reasoning and autonomous resolution
Drag-and-drop interface for clients to update bot copies/messages
Omnichannel support across Mobile App, Web and WhatsApp with shared context
Customer authentication/verification via existing OTP services
Live agent chat, rule-based Bot-to-Agent handover and conversation context transfer

Agent Assist: conversation summary, recommended responses, knowledge suggestions, next-best actions, case wrap-up summaries, AI-generated replies, conversation catch-up, case classification, sentiment analysis
Smart replies and macros using generative AI
Multi-language support (English plus applicable Indian/regional languages)
Proactive engagement driven by business events and triggers
Dashboards, scheduled reports, alerts, conversation analytics and AI performance monitoring
Survey triggered for every conversation, with closed-loop automatic case creation on negative feedback
Searchable conversation history and audit logs
integration_details: iOS/Android mobile apps - SDK, APIs, WebView or recommended mechanism
E-commerce website - web SDK, JavaScript, APIs or embeddable components; responsive desktop and mobile web
WhatsApp Business Platform/API - support, authentication, notifications, transactional journeys; BSP unknown
SAP Hybris Commerce/OMS - API type (REST/SOAP/OData) and version unknown
Existing CRM/customer-support platform - bot-to-agent handover, history transfer, case creation
Payment, Returns/Refunds, Loyalty, Catalogue, Customer Profile APIs
SMS, WhatsApp, Push Notification and Email services
Genesys - telephony/IVR (voice is out of current scope)
aws_services: Amazon Redshift (existing data warehouse with order data backup)
Amazon Bedrock - LLM inference for agentic chatbot, Agent Assist and handover summarization (proposed; referenced in vendor sizing Q&A)
Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases - RAG over FAQs/knowledge articles (proposed)
Amazon API Gateway - secure APIs/webhooks for channel and backend integration (proposed)
AWS Lambda - orchestration of backend API calls to SAP Hybris and other systems (proposed)
Amazon S3 - conversation history archive and data lake export (proposed)
Amazon CloudWatch - platform monitoring and alerting (proposed)
requirements.timeline: RFQ issued 12 Aug 2026; submissions due 17 Aug 2026; contract period 1 year with optional 2-year and 3-year pricing
